description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android Tic Tac Toe game with features such as game mode selection (single-player vs AI), player symbol choices, difficulty settings, and UI components for game interaction, including handling game logic, AI moves, and UI updates.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the Tic Tac Toe game, including UI initialization, game state, player interactions, game logic, and integration with AI and settings.

methods.name: applySettingsToControls
methods.description: Updates UI controls based on current game settings and preferences.

methods.name: updateModeUi
methods.description: Enables or disables UI components based on selected game mode (single-player or two-player).

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state, UI, and prepares for a new game based on current settings.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles user taps on game cells, applies moves, and triggers AI moves if necessary.

methods.name: maybeTriggerAiTurn
methods.description: Triggers the AI to make its move if the game mode involves AI and it's the AI's turn.

methods.name: applyMove
methods.description: Updates the game state and UI with a move at a specified position.

methods.name: endDraw
methods.description: Handles the game end condition when the match is a draw.

methods.name: lockBoardForAiThinking
methods.description: Disables all game cells while the AI is making a move to prevent user interaction.

methods.name: unlockBoardAfterAiThinking
methods.description: Re-enables user interaction with game cells after AI move completes.

methods.name: lockBoard
methods.description: Disables all game cells when the game ends.

methods.name: findWinner
methods.description: Determines if a player has won the game.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks if the game has resulted in a draw.

methods.name: updatePlayerIndicator
methods.description: Updates the UI to display the current player's turn.

methods.name: setBannerNeutral
methods.description: Sets a neutral message banner with accessibility announcement.

methods.name: setBannerWin
methods.description: Displays a winning message banner with appropriate styling.

methods.name: applyMarkStyling
methods.description: Sets visual styling for a move on the game board.

methods.name: other
methods.description: Returns the alternate symbol ('X' or 'O') for a given symbol.
